title: The $0 Side Hustle Anyone Can Start
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest co-founded Viral View and describes it as a tool for creators. The host says the video is not sponsored, but the guest has a direct commercial interest in the tool.

idea.name: Amazon onsite product video reviews
idea.one_liner: Creators film product demonstrations or reviews and upload them to Amazon; commissions are earned when shoppers buy, with possible extra payments from seller campaigns.
idea.customer: Amazon shoppers, whose purchases generate creator commissions.
idea.offer: Phone filmed product videos placed on Amazon product detail pages.
idea.revenue_model: Amazon affiliate commissions, including higher-rate Creator Connections campaigns; some creators also monetize through brand deals and video rights.

key_quotes.quote: We film video reviews with your phone and you upload them to Amazon. If somebody watches that video, buys the product, you get a commission.
And you don't even have to show your face if you don't want to.
And if you can get your video there, customers are gonna see it.
And I would say for a beginner coming in, you will easily make hundreds of dollars, very, very like conservative, a month, a month.
And there's people like me where I'm making over $10,000 per month doing these video reviews.
I do have a little bit of the experience when it comes to content, but I work no more than four to five hours per week doing these on these videos.
So the average person, they're taking that and they're making commissions for Amazon, but then they also have the resell value of the products that they're getting for free.
So there's agencies and most of these sellers are from China and basically they'll pay you $20 to $40 per video.
And you can sell that for another $40, $50, but there's people that are charging $500, $1,000 for these pieces of content.
So Amazon has their standard commission rates, and it's anywhere from a half a percent up to 3%.
And if you do, we will give you a 10, 20, up to 50% commission.
I knew that that product was selling so well, so what I ended up doing is I search other umbrellas stands on Amazon, and I ended up buying three others.
And in the last three months, since doing that, people are making more money than they ever have.
And over like the last year, it went from 40,000, 50,000 campaigns to over 800,000 campaigns.
So I personally don't do that, but I do know people that do and they'll kind of separate it to where like they'll have their sister or their sibling or whoever buy it and return it.
So basically they only need to do the video, the content.

acquisition_channels.details: Amazon product detail pages and video carousel expose the reviews to shoppers already browsing the product.
Seller-run Creator Connections campaigns offer increased commissions; brands may also send products or pay for videos.

ideas.delivery: The creator obtains or is sent a physical product, films a review or demonstration on a phone, and uploads it to Amazon. The creator can handle product selection, filming, and posting; some creators outsource editing and uploads to virtual assistants.
ideas.other_uk_rules: Creators should clearly disclose affiliate commissions and material brand relationships under UK advertising rules. Product claims should be accurate; using order-history data in tools should follow UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Amazon program terms also apply.

idea.name: Viral View influencer research and automation tool
idea.one_liner: A software tool for Amazon influencers that finds promising products, surfaces commission and competition data, and automates cross-posting and deep links.
idea.customer: Amazon influencers and product video creators.
idea.offer: Product research, commission and competition data, cross-posting, and deep-link automation.

key_quotes.quote: And now we have like 50 plus different features inside that tool, but essentially the tool is going to help you find better products.
And it's been three years. My brother and I started it.

claims.quote: And now we have like 50 plus different features inside that tool, but essentially the tool is going to help you find better products.

claims.quote: And it's been three years. My brother and I started it.

ideas.delivery: A software platform provides product and competition data plus posting and deep-link automations to creators.
ideas.other_uk_rules: If the software processes users' Amazon order histories or account data, UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 apply; the transcript does not describe its security or data practices.

idea.name: Selling products on Amazon
idea.one_liner: A seller lists products on Amazon and earns revenue when customers buy them, while paying platform, fulfilment, and advertising costs.
idea.revenue_model: Product sales minus inventory, Amazon fees, shipping, advertising, and other costs.

key_quotes.quote: So my background I sell products on Amazon.
And then they're shipping and then there's this and then there's ads and then there's tariffs and it just stacks up

ideas.delivery: The seller sources physical inventory, lists products on Amazon, and manages shipping and related operations.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK consumer, product safety, VAT, and distance-selling rules may apply depending on products and sales volume.

idea.name: TikTok affiliate videos
idea.one_liner: Creators make product videos for TikTok and earn affiliate commissions when viewers buy, with the guest saying this takes more on-camera skill than Amazon onsite reviews.
idea.customer: TikTok viewers whose purchases generate affiliate commission.
idea.revenue_model: Affiliate commissions on attributed purchases; rates and amounts not stated.
